response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced (15+ years) full-stack/web developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang expertise, but his C++ experience is minimal (roughly 6 months at National Instruments plus a university project) and there is no evidence of industrial automation, IEC 62443 security standards, MQTT, message-broker architectures, or IoT protocol experience required for this role. His profile is a poor match for a senior C++ industrial-platform architect position.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across many domains
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and public speaking/workshops
Demonstrated ability to work with low-latency, high-performance systems (DLang at Sociomantic)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) and not listed among core skills
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity background
No demonstrated experience with MQTT, REST-based IoT systems, or message-broker architectures in an industrial context

key_factors.factor: No industrial automation or IEC 62443 security experience
Extensive general software engineering seniority and adaptability
